description: This file defines the EmployeeDependentAPI class in the OrangeHRM system, which provides RESTful endpoints for managing employee dependents, including CRUD operations (create, read, update, delete), search, and listing functionalities. It integrates with underlying services and models to handle employee dependent data within the HRM system.

classes.name: EmployeeDependentAPI
classes.description: Provides REST API endpoints for managing employee dependents, including fetching, listing, creating, updating, and deleting dependents within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific employee dependent by employee number and dependent ID.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all dependents for a specific employee, with filtering, sorting, and pagination support.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new employee dependent record.

methods.name: saveEmpDependent
methods.description: Handles the logic for creating or updating an EmpDependent entity from request data.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the common body parameters used in create and update operations.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for fetching a single dependent.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for listing dependents.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes dependents for a specific employee based on provided IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for deleting dependents.
